|-|Guide=
{{Achievement|We Expect You to Die, Mr Buluc|jpg|In the [[Buluc's Mansion]] job, kill Buluc in a spectacular way.}}
*In the Inner Sanctum, there is a button in the meeting room that when pressed, will release the shark, leading to a spectacular death when Buluc falls off the balcony.
{{Achievement|Everything but the Patio Furniture|jpg|In the [[Buluc's Mansion]] job, secure all available loot bags in stealth.}}
*There are 21 bags of loot in the heist.
**9 in the main mansion.
***The inner sanctum has 3 bags of coke on the meeting room table, 
***There are 5 safes containing coke. The safes can be drilled, lockpicked, and blown open with shaped charges on all difficulties.
****In the meeting room in the inner sanctum
****Underneath the staircase in the inner sanctum
****In the small room next to the piano
****In the the bedroom next to Buluc's office
****In the bedroom between the inner sanctum and garage
***1 weapon case in the garage.
**The rest are behind the cage doors in the wine cellar.
**It is generally advised to get the boat entry pre-planning asset when going for all loot.
{{Achievement|Sugar, Lard and Scorpions|jpg|Find the churro. Unlocks the "Undead Peacock" mask.}}
*The plate of churros can be found on top of the chandelier in the main hall. Jump up to it from the stairs and pick it up to get the achievement.
{{Achievement|Only For Us Naughty Heisters|jpg|Find the hidden presents in the [[Border Crossing]], [[San Martín Bank]], [[Breakfast in Tijuana]], and [[Buluc's Mansion]] jobs. Unlocks the "Mega Sangres" mask.}}
*Click on this [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2322941991 link] to find all the present locations.

|-|Trivia=
*'''We Expect You to Die, Mr Buluc''' is a reference to the Shark Attack scene from the 2011 action movie ''{{w|Colombiana}}''.
*The teaser achievements translates to "A video game developer sees an assailant looking for clues in achievements. After a few minutes, the developer asks if you are sure the clues are here. The assailant responds, No, they are in discord. The developer asks why he's looking here, and the assailant replies: This is where the funny names are." from Spanish.
